lessons: Premise is false: clutch/merge.py write_squash calls git.merge_squash with squash_message, giving subject `clutch(<stem>): <Goal line>`. Check's `clutch(<stem>): select` commit stays on the ticket branch, so it is never reachable from HEAD after a normal merge.

Re-author the contract around evidence that survives the squash merge. The ticket does not say what durable merge provenance records a select, such as a trailer in squash_message or an artifact lifted to main, so the author must name it first.

If the fix adds a select trailer to clutch/merge.py squash_message, or makes Check lift a select record to main, fence that file and its tests. Otherwise, write a separate ticket that runs before this one and makes the change.

Acceptance criteria 1-3 use a fake history with a `clutch(art): select` commit on HEAD, which real merges never produce. Rewrite them against the chosen durable provenance so the tests match the real merge path.
